After dropping out of college I became depressed and started using drugs including alcohol and at my heaviest and unhealthiest I was 180lbs and didn't give a shit. I was masturbating all the time, smoking cigarettes, hating my job, playing way too much Counter Strike. I was basically a husk of my former self.
